candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Social Insights & Analytics. Turning data about digital audiences and creators into clear insights is a fresh area for me, and one where my analytics experience and curiosity would combine well.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau. Before moving to Germany I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data & analytics consulting at TallyMarks Consulting, building dashboards, data models and SQL-based reporting for business teams.

achievements.impact: I used SQL analysis, data validation and reconciliation to keep reporting accurate across HR, finance, supply chain and procurement
I built a Power BI dashboard for the CEO comparing monthly sales against the fiscal-year plan
I prepared and presented SAP Analytics Cloud to a client, who subsequently purchased it

letter.problems_section: In your team I would support research, analysis and reporting across projects, work with Excel and dashboards, and present findings clearly. I am new to the creator economy, so I would bring a fresh, data-driven perspective and learn the domain quickly.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for up to 20 hours per week and am happy to relocate to Berlin. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
